text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine for the sake of 
Narita Taishin, who wasn't feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After offering our prayers and drawing 
fortune slips—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I wondered where you were taking me out of 
the blue... To think you'd resort to 
praying to the gods.
choice_data_list:
I just hoped you would feel even a little 
better.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. If wishes came true through stuff 
like this, no one would ever have to work 
har—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's Taishin! Heeeeeeeeey!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you guys come to visit the shrine 
too, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
We're just about to head home, though. 
We've already done our prayers and drawn 
our fortunes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeehh?! Then one more time! This time, 
play with us! Come on! Please?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Twice is better than once! Three times is 
better than twice!! The more you pray, the 
more likely your wish will come true!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Winning Ticket's sheer 
enthusiasm, I ended up offering a prayer 
one more time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh Gods and Buddhas~! Please, make my wish 
come truuuueee!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are no Buddhas at a Shinto shrine, 
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't care less.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how did everyone's fortunes turn 
out? I got moderate blessing!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Good Fortune." Not bad at all. How about 
yours, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Great Blessing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special; getting "Great 
Blessing" isn't exactly rare, is it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I got Excellent Luck, 
after all?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If we combine my moderate blessing with 
Hayahide's blessing, our wishes are 
guaranteed to come true!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin will be right back in top shape in 
no time flat!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"......Ah, actually, well. I came to pray 
today that you'd start feeling better."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because when it comes to rivals, I want us 
to compete in top condition.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's with that...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nobody asked you to do that... ...Dummy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as if the prayers of Narita 
Taishin and those around her were 
answered, the slump that had troubled her 
was resolved.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Great Curse.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Totally agreed! After the worst luck comes 
the best luck, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it looks like the fortune 
slips are already sold out."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehk!? But Taishin, you'll still be 
stuck with Great Curse!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, I don't really mind, so...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm gonna worryyyyyy~!! Daijin 
looks so pitifullllll!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, so loud!! Stop crying already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin managed to calm Winning 
Ticket down afterward, but in the end, her 
own slump remained unresolved.
